relations.text: テスタを国際的なメーカーであるアドバンテストから購入している
relations.text_en: Purchases testers from international manufacturers including Advantest Corporation

source.label: ChipMOS Technologies 20-F
source.quote: We purchase testers from international manufacturers Advantest Corporation.

relations.text: TCP関連のテスタを追加でアドバンテストから購入した
relations.text_en: Subsequently purchased additional TCP-related testers from Advantest Corporation

source.label: ChipMOS Technologies 20-F
source.quote: We subsequently purchased additional TCP-related testers from Advantest Corporation and assembly equipment from Shibaura Mechatronics Corp.

relations.text: 機械設備と付属品の取得の取引相手は、アドバンテストの台湾法人だ
relations.text_en: The counterparty to the acquisition of machinery equipment and related accessories is Advantest Taiwan Inc.

source.label: ChipMOS Form 6-K
source.quote: Trading counterparty: ADVANTEST TAIWAN INC. Relation with the Company: None
source.note: 取引相手は台湾の子会社(Advantest Taiwan)です。
source.note_en: The counterparty is the Taiwan subsidiary (Advantest Taiwan).

relations.text: 組立装置を芝浦メカトロニクスから購入した
relations.text_en: Purchased assembly equipment from Shibaura Mechatronics Corp.

source.label: ChipMOS Technologies 20-F
source.quote: We subsequently purchased additional TCP-related testers from Advantest Corporation and assembly equipment from Shibaura Mechatronics Corp.

relations.text: ChipMOSが建物と付帯設備を取得する取引の相手方は、群創光電である
relations.text_en: INNOLUX is the counterparty to ChipMOS's acquisition of a building and related facilities.

source.label: ChipMOS Form 6-K
source.quote: Trading counterpart: INNOLUX Corporation; Relation with the Company: None
source.note: 提出書類の「取引相手」欄の記載のみです。
source.note_en: Named only as the trading counterparty in the filing.

relations.text: ChipMOSは、HimaxのTABやCOGパッケージの組立・テスト委託先に当たる
relations.text_en: ChipMOS is an assembly and testing house Himax engages for TAB and COG packages.

source.label: Himax Technologies 20-F
source.quote: We engage assembly and testing houses that specialize in TAB and COG packages such as Chipbond, Chipmore International trading company Ltd., ChipMOS Technologies Inc. and King Yuan Electronics Co., Ltd, etc.

relations.text: グリーン製品要求に適合した製品について、日本のソニーからグリーンパートナー認証を取得した
relations.text_en: Obtained Green Partner certification from Sony Corporation of Japan for products conforming to its Green Product Requirement

source.label: ChipMOS Technologies 20-F
source.quote: For products in conformity with Green Product Requirement, the Company obtained Green Partner certification from Sony Corporation of Japan.
source.note: 認証取得の記載のみです。

relations.text: ソニーの認証は途切れることなく維持されている
relations.text_en: The Sony certificates continue to be maintained uninterrupted

source.label: ChipMOS Technologies 20-F
source.quote: The Sony certificates will continue to be maintained uninterrupted until now.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
